annotations.title: An App Store offer code's codes

description: The codes of one App Store offer code (offerId "code:…" from ploa_offers_get). action list: its batches of one-time codes and its custom codes, each with an id, count, expiry and whether it still works. action create (values { kind: one_time | custom, count, expires: YYYY-MM-DD, customCode for custom }): one-time codes (up to 25,000 a batch) Apple makes in a few minutes, or one custom code people type (count is how many times it can be redeemed); from an agent this waits for a person's approval. action download (batchId of one-time codes, saveTo an absolute path for the CSV file): writes the codes to that file and says how many; it never prints them. action end (batchId): those codes stop working.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
